subject: Intermittent latency + 5xx affecting production — proposed resolution & credits
messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@aureliahealth.com>
To: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Desai <samir.desai@aureliahealth.com>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intermittent latency and 5xx errors impacting production — immediate exec attention requested

Hi Rohan / Markus,

We’re seeing recurrent latency spikes and 5xx error bursts from the Redwood inference endpoints backing our patient triage microservice since yesterday afternoon. Baseline token latency is normally ~120-160ms; we’re seeing sustained p95 jumps to ~1.8s and a handful of 5xx errors (approx 4.7% of requests in several five-minute windows). Overall throughput to our service dropped by ~28% during the worst interval.

This is affecting our internal workflows and patient intake SLAs — we had to fall back to a cached response path for several calls. Our SREs captured traces and logs (attached: aurelia_incident_logs_aug7.zip) and a short latency chart showing the p50/p95/p99 deviation.

We need:
- A short incident update and ETA for stabilization within 24 hours
- Confirmation of whether this qualifies as an SLA breach and what credits/remediation you will offer
- A commitment for a post-incident RCA and mitigation plan within 10 business days

Given the business impact, I’m escalating to execs on our side; please escalate on yours. Happy to jump on a call — Samir and I are available this afternoon (PST) or tomorrow.

Thanks,
Lena Ortiz
Director, Platform Ops
Aurelia Health

Attachments: aurelia_incident_logs_aug7.zip
From: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 7 Aug 2026 09:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intermittent latency and 5xx errors impacting production — immediate exec attention requested

Lena — thank you for the quick heads-up and for the logs. I’m escalating to our SRE and infra teams now and we’ll prioritize a hotfix.

Immediate actions we’ve taken:
- Opened an incident (INC-9642) and applied temporary request routing to a warmed pool of capacity to reduce cold-start effects.
- Throttled non-essential background inference jobs for your org for the next 6 hours to free throughput.
- Engineering is instrumenting additional KPIs (queue depth, kernel failures) and will push a trace summary shortly.

I’ll set up a 30-minute bridge with your SREs and our ops leads in the next 2 hours. We’ll also prepare a preliminary assessment on whether this meets the SLA thresholds.

Can you confirm the best contact for the bridge? (Samir or someone else?)

—Rohan
Account Exec, Redwood Inference

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>

Cc: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Aurelia surge — proposed short-term credit + ops plan (internal)

Team — looping you both so we can move fast on a customer-grade resolution. Summary: Aurelia saw sustained latency p95 > 1.5s and 5xx spikes ~4-5% on Aug 7 with a throughput impact. They’ve asked explicitly for confirmation of SLA breach and credit/mitigation proposals; they’ve escalated to their execs.

Quick asks:
- Jonas: please confirm whether the root cause we saw (container preemption on a noisy host + KV cache invalidation during a compaction window) has been fully mitigated. If not, apply the hotfix and confirm capacity headroom for Aurelia for the next 72 hours.
- Monica: finance needs a conservative credit offer to present that balances goodwill and precedent. We should open with a one-time invoice credit and a short operational guarantee.

Draft commercial offer (internal calc attached: proposed_credit_calc.xlsx):
- One-time invoice credit equal to 10% of August estimated usage (quick offer) OR an escalated offer of 20% if the RCA shows an aggregate availability drop below 99.5% across the affected windows.
- Two weeks of prioritized dedicated capacity (no charge) for their critical routes to prevent recurrence while we implement kernel-level fixes.
- Priority RCA with a full timeline delivered within 10 business days and a follow-up remediation roadmap.

We should present the higher option if the RCA indicates systemic failures on our side. Keep messaging concise and own the timeline. I’ll prepare an external note for their execs if you confirm the mitigations.

Markus
VP, Sales Operations

Attachments: proposed_credit_calc.xlsx
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@aureliahealth.com>, Samir Desai <samir.desai@aureliahealth.com>
Cc: Rohan Mehta <rohan.mehta@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Aug 2026 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Formal offer: interim credits and operational safeguards following Aug 7 disruption

Lena / Samir — thanks for your patience while we investigated. We take incidents like this seriously and want to make this right. Below is the formal proposal from Redwood to address the impact on your production environment: 

Our offer
1) Credit: a one-time invoice credit equal to 20% of Aurelia’s billed usage for August 2026, conditional on the RCA confirming our exposure during the affected windows (we’ve already identified preemption + KV compaction as primary contributors). If the RCA shows the issue was less than 50% attributable to our serving layer, we will revert to a 10% credit.
2) Operational safeguard: two (2) weeks of prioritized dedicated capacity for your critical inference routes (no charge) starting on acceptance. This will be provisioned in your existing region and monitored by our SRE team.
3) RCA & timeline: full technical RCA and mitigation plan delivered within 10 business days from acceptance, with a separate exec summary for leadership.

Next steps
- Please reply to this thread with acceptance of the terms or a counter-proposal by EOD Monday, Aug 16.
- If accepted, we’ll provision the dedicated capacity within 48 hours and apply the invoice credit to your Aug billing cycle.

If you’d prefer a quick call to go over the offer, Rohan and I are available tomorrow morning. We appreciate the partnership and want to ensure your platform reliability going forward.

Best,
Markus Klein
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: credit_offer_20260812.pdf, rca_timeline.md
